en: Color postcard showing a sandy beach lined with many tents, cars and a few camper vans along the Black Sea coast. People are sunbathing and swimming. The back has Romanian handwriting, a blue 40 Bani POSTA ROMANA stamp with a Mangalia cancellation, and printed caption identifying the place as 2 Mai beach. Publisher: Editura Meridiane; photo credit Al. Mendrea; price Lei 1,50.
